# SiteIndex Website Score

> Free, embeddable website audit widget. Paste any public URL to score SEO, performance, security, and accessibility. No signup.

## Embed the full audit widget
<iframe src="https://www.siteindex.app/embed/website-score" width="100%" height="1100" style="border:0;border-radius:12px" title="Free Website SEO Score Checker"></iframe>

## Embed a per-domain score badge
https://www.siteindex.app/embed/website-score/{domain}?style=standard

## Links
- Tool: https://www.siteindex.app/tools/website-score
- Embed: https://www.siteindex.app/embed/website-score
- Demo and docs: https://imgagan08.github.io/website-score-widget/
- Source: https://github.com/imgagan08/website-score-widget

## Notes
- Audits one public page per run; informational heuristic, not a Google ranking score.
- Score history stored privately in the visitor's browser (local storage).
